title: Ecosystem Wars
description: A chess-inspired strategy game where you lead your ecosystem's apex predators against an invasion of rival species. Command your Apex Predator, Alpha Hunter, Territorial Guards, Ambush Predators, Scouts, and Herd Animals across a wild landscape. Capture enemy creatures, control resource-rich habitats, and build your ecosystem's dominance to achieve a valuation of $10M.
learning_objectives: Understand predator-prey relationships and food chain dynamics
Develop strategic thinking through territorial control and resource management
Learn about ecosystem balance and the impact of invasive species
Practice risk assessment when committing apex predators to combat
Explore how different species' strengths and weaknesses create interdependent survival strategies
Recognize the importance of biodiversity and niche specialization in a functioning ecosystem
how_to_play: Each turn you get 2 Action Points (AP). Moving a creature costs 1 AP, and using a special ability costs AP as listed on the ability.

Creatures move like chess pieces: Apex Predator moves 1 square any direction, Alpha Hunter moves any distance in any direction, Territorial Guards move in straight lines, Ambush Predators move diagonally, Scouts leap in L-shapes, and Herd Animals advance forward only.
Capture enemy creatures by moving onto their square. Herd Animals evolve into Alpha Hunters when they reach the far side of the territory.
Control resource tiles like Watering Holes and Berry Groves by placing your creatures on them. Each habitat generates ecosystem income per turn.
Win by capturing the enemy Apex Predator, controlling 3 or more resource habitats, or reaching $10M ecosystem dominance valuation.
Use special abilities wisely — an Apex Predator can rally nearby allies, Scouts can deploy decoys, and Herd Animals can heal injured packmates with foraging runs.
objectives: Capture the rival Apex Predator to instantly claim territorial supremacy
Control 3 or more resource habitats for an ecosystem domination victory
Build your ecosystem dominance valuation to $10 million

storybook_pages.title: The Wilds Await
storybook_pages.text: Two rival ecosystems clash at the boundary of an untamed wilderness. Your pride of apex predators, alpha hunters, territorial guards, ambush predators, scouts, and herd animals must outmaneuver the invasive species threatening your homeland. Every watering hole, berry grove, and nesting ground is contested territory. Only the strongest ecosystem will survive.
storybook_pages.image_prompt: Two groups of wild animals facing each other across a lush savanna landscape divided by a river, lions and wolves on one side, rival predators on the other, dramatic golden hour lighting, nature documentary style digital art

storybook_pages.title: Know Your Pack
storybook_pages.text:
Apex Predator (King) — Your pride leader, lose them and the ecosystem collapses.
Alpha Hunter (Queen) — Swift and deadly, hunts in any direction.
Territorial Guard (Rook) — Patrols straight corridors with unwavering vigilance.
Ambush Predator (Bishop) — Strikes from hidden diagonal angles.
Scout (Knight) — Agile fox that leaps unpredictably over obstacles.
Herd Animal (Pawn) — Strength in numbers, evolves into an Alpha Hunter at the far territory!
storybook_pages.image_prompt: Six wild animals arranged as game characters: a lion with a crown, a wolf, an eagle, a snake, a fox, and a deer, each in a portrait frame with stats displayed, colorful illustrated game character design

storybook_pages.title: Fight for the Wild
storybook_pages.text: The battlefield is an 8x8 grid of wilderness hexes with 6 precious resource habitats: Watering Holes, Berry Groves, Nesting Grounds, Fish Rivers, Grazing Meadows, and Cave Dens. Control these habitats to sustain your ecosystem. Push your herd animals across the territory to evolve them into fearsome alpha hunters. The law of the jungle favors the bold — and the strategic.
storybook_pages.image_prompt: Birds-eye view of a lush 8x8 game board with glowing habitat tiles showing water, berries, nests, fish, grass, and caves, surrounded by wilderness, nature-themed board game art with vibrant colors

abilities.name: Territorial Roar

strengths.name: Apex Mobility

strengths.name: Pack Tactics

strengths.name: Unyielding Alpha

weaknesses.name: Lone Wolf Penalty

weaknesses.name: Stamina Drain

weaknesses.name: Restless Predator

abilities.name: Pounce

abilities.name: Lick Wounds

strengths.name: Corridor Patrol

strengths.name: Scavenger Bonus
strengths.desc: +$100K ecosystem value bonus when capturing any enemy creature

strengths.name: Habitat Defense

weaknesses.name: No Diagonal Vision
weaknesses.desc: Cannot move or attack diagonally — blind to flanking maneuvers

weaknesses.name: Territorial Stress

weaknesses.name: Committed Charge

abilities.name: Forage Claim

abilities.name: Intimidating Screech
abilities.desc: Screech at an enemy within 3 squares, weakening them by -2 ATK

strengths.name: Diagonal Domination
strengths.desc: Controls long diagonals — masters of surprise cross-territory ambushes

strengths.name: Venom Aura

strengths.name: Constriction

weaknesses.name: No Straight Movement

weaknesses.name: Fragile Scales

abilities.name: Venom Strike

abilities.name: Camouflage Swap
abilities.desc: Use camouflage to swap positions with any friendly creature on the board

strengths.name: Agile Leaper
strengths.desc: Unique L-shaped movement that leaps over other creatures — unpredictable and evasive

strengths.name: Cunning Strike
strengths.desc: +2 ATK when attacking from an unexpected angle — foxes are clever hunters

strengths.name: Thick Fur

weaknesses.name: Forward Migration
weaknesses.desc: Can only move forward toward the opposing territory, never backward

weaknesses.name: Fragile

weaknesses.name: Diagonal Charge Only

abilities.name: Foraging Run

abilities.name: Herd Migration

rounds.title: Ecosystem Wars
rounds.story: The wilderness is contested. Invasive species encroach on every habitat. Lead your ecosystem's creatures to territorial supremacy — control the watering holes, protect your apex predator, and evolve your herd animals into unstoppable alpha hunters!
rounds.coaching_moment: Think carefully about the trade-offs before committing to this path.
rounds.reflection_prompt: What sacrifices did you make, and were they worth it?

glossary_terms.definition: The process of selecting among alternatives based on available information and values.
glossary_terms.example: Choosing between two career paths based on income, passion, and long-term growth.
glossary_terms.deep_dive: Good decision-making combines rational analysis with awareness of cognitive biases that distort judgment.
glossary_terms.real_world_example: Leaders make high-stakes decisions daily — the quality of their process matters as much as the decision itself.

glossary_terms.definition: Analyzing information objectively to form a well-reasoned judgment.
glossary_terms.example: Questioning whether a statistic is representative before using it to make a decision.
glossary_terms.deep_dive: Critical thinking involves identifying assumptions, evaluating evidence, and considering alternative perspectives.
glossary_terms.real_world_example: Journalists fact-check before publishing; scientists replicate experiments before claiming discoveries.

glossary_terms.definition: The belief that abilities can be developed through effort and learning from failure.
glossary_terms.example: Seeing a poor game result as feedback on what to practice, not evidence of being bad at the game.
glossary_terms.deep_dive: Research by Carol Dweck shows people with growth mindsets achieve more and recover better from setbacks.
glossary_terms.real_world_example: Students who believe intelligence is fixed give up when challenged; those with growth mindset persist and improve.
